stem.text: The diagram shows an experiment using a model cell to investigate the movement of substances.

stem.alt: Diagram of a model cell, a membrane-lined sac inside a tube, with printed labels for the model cell, the membrane, and the two solutions, including their sucrose and glucose concentrations in mol dm-3.

items: There is net movement of sucrose out of the model cell.
There is net movement of glucose out of the model cell.
There is net movement of water into the model cell.
